Walk around in [[Old Ascalon]] and kill 5 [[Hulking Stone Elemental]]s.

==Quest Information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = elementalist
}}

===Objectives===
* 0/5 [[Hulking Stone Elemental]]s slain.
* Return to Elementalist Aziure for your reward.

===Reward===
*200 [[Experience]]
*50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
*{{skill icon|Ward Against Elements}}

==Walkthrough==
* After accepting this quest, simply wander around [[Old Ascalon]] and you will find plenty of Hulking Stone Elementals to kill to complete this quest. They are particularly concentrated in areas to the west of Elementalist Aziure.

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Elementalist Aziure
:''"So you want to wield the power of the elements, do you? First, you must prove you are worthy of learning the secrets of the Elementalist. Use fire to overcome the power of earth. Defeat '''5 hulking stone elementals''' and then return to me. Do you think you can do this?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will wield fire to defeat earth.
| decline = I don't think I'm ready for this.
| ask = Overcome earth through the power of fire. Defeat 5 '''hulking stone elementals'''.
}}

===Reward Dialogue===
;Elementalist Aziure
:''"You are on your way to walking the path to greater understanding. Well done."''

==Notes==
* The counter will increase if other creatures, such as patrolling [[grawl]], kill elementals.
* Other types of stone elemental, including [[boss]]es such as [[Flint Touchstone]] and [[Cobble Poundstone]], do not increase the counter.
* Plenty of Hulking Stone Elementals can be found along the way to [[Shalev the Hermit]]'s cave while completing [[Elemental Knowledge]].
{{bug|The counter for x/5 Hulking Stone Elementals sometimes goes up even if you kill foes that aren't Hulking Stone Elementals.}}
